overview: The SLS-SoM-i.MX6ULL is a high-performance, ultra-miniature, soldered system on module built on the NXP i.MX 6ULL applications processor family, featuring an advanced implementation of a single Arm Cortex-A7 core operating at up to 528 MHz.

It integrates power management, system control, multimedia, memory, basic security modules and other hardware options along with a variety of connectivity interfaces for optimal flexibility and user experience.

The module ships with SLS-SoM-YBSP, a fully tested and validated board support package and device drivers with Yocto Linux support, for reliable long-term deployment in industrial applications. Its cost-optimised bill of material and single-sided assembly make it suited to cost-effective high-volume production.

why.d: UltraLite i.MX6ULL with hardware and software power management.
Dual Ethernet, dual CAN, USB Host + OTG, 8 × UART, 4 × I2C, 4 × SPI and up to 97 GPIO.
Arm TrustZone, AES-128 encryption, e-fuse, RNG and secure RTC.
Yocto Linux BSP (SLS-SoM-YBSP) with source code for drivers and bootloader.
10+ years of product availability and global technical support.

rows: 39 mm (L) × 37 mm (W) × 4 mm (H) without shield; 39 × 37 × 5 mm with shield
USB Host/OTG, I2C, SPI, Ethernet, eMMC/SD, cellular, PWM, ADC, RTC, GPIO, UART, CAN, RS485 (Modbus)
SLS-Image-Core (customised SLS BSP), IMX-Image-Core (i.MX default BSP)

spec_note: Specification values as published in the SLS-SoM-MX6 brochure (version 1.0, April 2025).

features.d: Single Arm Cortex-A7 core up to 528 MHz with NEON.
Hardware and software support for low-power designs.
Arm TrustZone, AES-128 encryption, e-fuse, RNG and secure RTC.
Memory on module, with an on-board Ethernet PHY and power supply circuit.
Plus dual USB 2.0 (OTG & Host), UART, I2C, SPI and GPIO.
Camera, LCD and audio for graphics and video hardware acceleration.
SLS-SoM-YBSP with Linux 5.15.71, U-Boot and ready-to-use APIs.
1.0 mm pitch expansion interface for solderable, single-sided assembly.

apps.d: Panels and HMIs with LCD and touch.
